After normal Express import call assertSealed. It validates and returns the genuine cached own-data exports constructor, with no reimport, bypassed savedload, reopened initialization or new resolver. That same pointer is used by the three live ADMISSION probes.

For a changed/fake/proxy/accessor/module-cache/prototype/filename/id/exports/loaded state, latch FAILED irreversibly and reject before forward. Any actual live detection aborts that application attempt. Restoring descriptors, rerunning assertSealed, replacing the helper or creating another guard may never recover that live run.

Both existing native wrappers call the one common guard before string methods, counters, substitutions, optional handling, builtin/cache checks or native forwarding. Parentnull main entry and valid unrelated module forwards retain existing behavior; no generic new role/capability is created.
